name: Mikolection After Epilogue 1
original_name: みこれくしょん after epilogue 1
source:
After becoming boyfriend and girlfriend, the girl suddenly declares that sex is off limits. 
The protagonist is quite put-off but endures the situation as best he can.

Fast forward one year... 
The two were having a hard time as lovers, 
but then one autumn night something happens that will change their relationship forever...

[From [url=http://www.dlsite.com/ecchi-eng/work/=/product_id/RE235306.html]DLsite English[/url]]
